title: Labelled instruction transition action
statement: Let $A$ assign an instruction to each label in a set $\Lambda$. For a label, phase, optional Boolean input symbol, and register contents, define the one-step action to be the instruction transition action for the instruction assigned to that label, with states given by pairs of labels and phases.
